ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_sqrt_advantage_gap_sum
ir.intuition: Transforms the original mean aggregation to sum aggregation to intensify the total penalty over the batch while keeping the pairwise hinge margin loss weighted by sqrt advantage gap.
ir.pseudocode:
diff = lpw - lpl
hinge = max(0, margin - diff)
weighting = sqrt(abs(advantage_gap))
loss = weighting * hinge
return sum(loss * weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    margin = float(extra.get('margin', 1.0))
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    zero = ops.zeros_like(diff)
    hinge = ops.max(ops.sub(margin, diff), zero)
    weighting = ops.sqrt(ops.abs(adv_gap))
    loss = ops.mul(weighting, hinge)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
